note: Deliberate benchmark bugs in this variant, specified by the project owner on 2026-09-24. Every changed line in the game carries 'INJECTED BUG <id>'; diff_sha256 pins the exact clean->bugged diff that was validated (reporting/variants.py, tests/test_game_variants.py, tests/test_injected_bugs.py). Coordinates are level pixels: x grows right from the level start, y grows DOWN from the top of the screen (ground top y 538, screen height 600).
specified_by: project owner, 2026-09-24 (six benchmark bugs, locations left to the implementer)

bugs.name: Stair clipping
bugs.summary: The two tall columns at the top of the first staircase have colliders two tiles too low, so their two drawn top blocks have no collision.
bugs.location: First staircase (the pyramid pair around x 5745-6170): the two top blocks of step4 (x 5874-5914) and step5 (x 6001-6041), drawn at y 366-452.
bugs.trigger: Landing on top of either column, walking from step3 (or step6) into it, or any contact with those top blocks.
bugs.expected_clean: Mario stands on the columns at y 366 and is blocked by their faces.
bugs.injected_behaviour: Mario sinks 86 px into the column (standing at y 452, wholly inside its drawn top blocks) and walks straight into the blocks from step3. The rest of the staircase is unchanged. Side effect: the gap between the two pyramids, a trap in the clean game, becomes easy to climb out of.
bugs.implementation: level1.py setup_steps(): step4 and step5 colliders start at y 452 (height 90) instead of y 366 (height 176).
bugs.reproducibility: Deterministic. tests/bug_probe.py 'land_on_step4', 'land_on_step5', 'walk_step3_into_step4' (control: 'control_land_on_step13', identical on both games).
bugs.objective3_detection: Detected by the generic solid-penetration invariant (reporting/collision_invariants.py): kind 'clip_into_step', one incident per column; reproduced.

bugs.name: Pipe clipping
bugs.summary: Only the left rim of pipe 4 is solid, so Mario sinks into the pipe from its top and walks into it from the right.
bugs.location: Pipe 4 (the fourth, tall pipe): drawn at x 2445-2528, y 366-536. Its collider now covers only x 2445-2466.
bugs.trigger: Walking along the pipe's top past x 2466, landing on its top right of x 2466, or walking left into its right side.
bugs.expected_clean: The whole 83 px pipe is solid: Mario walks across its top and is stopped by either side (at x 2445 from the left, 2528 from the right).
bugs.injected_behaviour: Mario drops into the pipe from its top (up to 40 px deep - his full height - inside the drawn pipe) and, from the right, walks 62 px into it before the rim stops him. Other pipes are untouched.
bugs.implementation: level1.py setup_pipes(): pipe4 collider width 21 instead of 83.
bugs.reproducibility: Deterministic. tests/bug_probe.py 'pipe4_walk_top', 'pipe4_walk_in_from_right' (controls on pipe 3, identical on both games).
bugs.objective3_detection: Detected by the generic solid-penetration invariant: kind 'clip_into_pipe'; reproduced.

bugs.name: Ceiling clipping
bugs.summary: A lone brick does not stop Mario while he is moving up, so a jump from below passes straight through it.
bugs.location: The lone plain brick at x 5058-5101, y 365-408, over open ground (brick20).
bugs.trigger: Jumping into the brick from below (any overlap while Mario's y velocity is negative).
bugs.expected_clean: Mario's head hits the brick bottom (y 408), the brick bumps, and he falls back.
bugs.injected_behaviour: No collision while rising: Mario's body passes through the brick (fully inside it, 30x40 px) up to top y 332; no bump. Falling onto it and walking into its sides still collide.
bugs.implementation: level1.py: brick20.solid_from_below = False (setup_bricks); check_mario_x_collisions() and check_mario_y_collisions() ignore such a brick while self.mario.y_vel < 0.
bugs.reproducibility: Deterministic. tests/bug_probe.py 'jump_under_brick20' (control: 'control_jump_under_brick18', identical on both games).
bugs.objective3_detection: Detected by the generic solid-penetration invariant: kind 'clip_into_block', entered from the bottom (a ceiling clip); reproduced.

bugs.name: Invisible wall
bugs.summary: A stray two-tile collider on open, empty ground blocks Mario although nothing is drawn there.
bugs.location: Open ground between the bricks at x 4287-4373 and the ? block at x 4544: x 4412-4452, y 452-538 (two tiles high). No block overhead, no bush or hill (the nearest ground decorations end at x 4323 and start at 4611); the drawn pixels there are identical to mario_clean's.
bugs.trigger: Walking or jumping into x 4412 below y 452 from either side; landing on y 452 above it.
bugs.injected_behaviour: Mario is stopped at x 4412 (right edge) by empty space, and can stand on thin air at y 452. Enemies (the Koopa near x 4400-4500) also turn around there, as at any step.
bugs.implementation: level1.py setup_steps(): extra collider 'stray_step' added to step_group.
bugs.reproducibility: Deterministic. tests/bug_probe.py 'walk_across_wall_spot' (control: 'control_walk_across_open_spot', identical on both games).
bugs.objective3_detection: Detected by the generic collision-with-nothing invariant: kind 'invisible_collision' (side stop and standing on it); reproduced.

bugs.name: False Goomba hit / early death
bugs.summary: One Goomba's hurt box is 36 px bigger than its sprite on every side, so it hurts Mario before they touch - including from above, before a stomp can land.
bugs.location: goomba14: the leading Goomba of the last pair, spawned when Mario reaches the checkpoint at x 6800 (it walks left from the right edge of the screen toward pipe 5 / the bricks near x 7100-7300).
bugs.trigger: Mario within 36 px of that Goomba on any side while it is alive.
bugs.expected_clean: A Goomba hurts Mario only when their colliders touch (gap 0); landing on it stomps it.
bugs.injected_behaviour: Mario dies (small) or shrinks (big) with 32-36 px of clear space between them; he cannot stomp this Goomba (the hit registers before his feet reach it). Its partner goomba15 and every other enemy are unchanged.
bugs.implementation: level1.py: goomba14.hurt_margin = 36 (setup_enemies); Level1.enemy_in_hurt_margin() used by check_mario_x_collisions() when no real enemy overlap exists.
bugs.reproducibility: Deterministic. tests/bug_probe.py 'goomba14_walks_into_mario' (controls: 'control_goomba15_walks_into_mario', 'control_goomba12_walks_into_mario', identical on both games).
bugs.objective3_detection: Detected by the generic hit-without-contact invariant: kind 'hit_without_contact' (gap ~33 px); reproduced.

bugs.name: Abnormal open-sky jump
bugs.summary: A jump that starts in the open sky near the start of the level launches Mario far above the top of the screen.
bugs.subsystem: player physics (jump impulse and variable-height jump)
bugs.location: Open sky at the start of Level 1-1, before the first ? block: jump take-off with Mario's left edge at level x 250-480 (ground level, nothing overhead up to the first blocks at x 685).
bugs.trigger: Any jump started (from standing or walking) while mario.rect.x is within 250..480.
bugs.expected_clean: Take-off velocity -10 (-10.5 when running); releasing jump cuts the rise short. Highest point from the ground: top y 332 (held), 415 (4-frame tap).
bugs.injected_behaviour: Take-off velocity x2.2 (-22 / -23.1) and releasing jump no longer cuts the rise. Mario rises about 780 px, to top y -294 (tap or hold alike), i.e. about 300 px above the top of the screen, then falls back.
bugs.implementation: mario.py: SKY_JUMP_ZONE_X / SKY_JUMP_FACTOR, Mario.apply_sky_jump_defect() called at both take-off sites (standing(), walking()); jumping() skips the release cut-off while self.sky_jump; falling() clears the flag.
bugs.reproducibility: Deterministic. tests/bug_probe.py 'tap_jump_at_x300' and 'held_jump_at_x300' (control: 'control_held_jump_at_x600', identical on both games).
bugs.objective3_detection: Detected at take-off by the generic jump-physics invariant (kind 'impossible_jump': 23.1 px/frame vs the engine's fastest 12.5), and later by the pre-existing above_world invariant (y < -200); both reproduced.
